title: 2025 PLN Statistics reconciliation: source-documented named PLTU site additions

summary_stats.scope: 2025 PLN statistics. PLN Group-owned units and the national including IPP/leased installed MW series have different ownership/perimeter; neither is an exhaustive plant-name register.

methodology: Named additions are specific IPP or existing complex units absent from the map's earlier 39-PLTU location list. Some are sub-plants within existing complexes; do not treat this as unique plant count, nor sum MW across overlapping campus totals. 2025 PLN statistics is an aggregate baseline; entries use site-specific original disclosures spanning 2012–2026. Operator, unit, fiscal CAPEX, nameplate, net output and physical production are different measures.
